---
title: "Modelos con moderadores"
format: html

execute: 
  echo: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}

source(here::here("script/proc_data.R"))

# Convertimos las variables de control a factores
data <- data %>%
  mutate(across(c(
    # Variables SAE
    disclosure, inf_situacional, control_humano,
    # Variables FONASA
    ai_disclosure_fonasa, control_humano_fonasa, performance_fonasa
  ), as.factor))

data <- data%>%
  filter(eliminado == 0)

library(sjPlot)

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    attitudes_tech = rowMeans(
      select(., starts_with("pre_general_attitudes_tech")),
      na.rm = TRUE),
    alfabetizacion_digital = rowMeans(
      select(., starts_with("alfabetizacion_digital")),
      na.rm = TRUE),  
    ai_skills = rowMeans(
      select(., starts_with("ai_skills")),
      na.rm = TRUE), 
    attitudes_ai = rowMeans(
      select(., starts_with("general_attitudes_ai")),
      na.rm = TRUE),
    get_variable_ord = ifelse(get_variable_ord == 1, "Fonasa", "SAE"),
    uso_sae = rowMeans(
      select(., starts_with("sae_familiaridad_uso")),
      na.rm = TRUE),
    sae_familiaridad_3 = ifelse(sae_familiaridad_3 == "No sé.", "No.", sae_familiaridad_3)
)

```

# Fonasa

## Hipótesis 1

```{r}
## =========================================================
## 0. Moderador: Familiaridad
## =========================================================
tab_model(
  list(
lm(fonasa_comp_objetiva_pre ~ ai_disclosure_fonasa + fonasa_familiaridad_3, data = data),
lm(fonasa_comp_objetiva_pre ~ ai_disclosure_fonasa + ai_disclosure_fonasa*fonasa_familiaridad_3, data = data),
lm(fonasa_comp_subjetiva_pre ~ ai_disclosure_fonasa + fonasa_familiaridad_3, data = data),
lm(fonasa_comp_subjetiva_pre ~ ai_disclosure_fonasa + ai_disclosure_fonasa*fonasa_familiaridad_3, data = data),
lm(fonasa_conf_word_moral_pre ~ ai_disclosure_fonasa + fonasa_familiaridad_3, data = data),
lm(fonasa_conf_word_moral_pre ~ ai_disclosure_fonasa + ai_disclosure_fonasa*fonasa_familiaridad_3, data = data)
  ),
  collapse.se = TRUE,      
  show.ci = FALSE,
  show.aic = FALSE,
  show.r2 = TRUE,
  show.fstat = TRUE,
  p.style = "stars",
  dv.labels = c("Objective knowledge","Objective knowledge", "Subjective knowledge","Subjective knowledge", "Moral trust (MDMT)", "Moral trust (MDMT)"),
  pred.labels = c("Intercept", "AI disclosure (Ex-Ante)", "Familiaridad: Sí", "Ai Disclosure*Familiaridad")
)

## =========================================================
## 1. Moderador: Dispositivo (Móvil)
## =========================================================
tab_model(
  list(
    lm(fonasa_comp_objetiva_pre ~ ai_disclosure_fonasa + device_type, data = data),
    lm(fonasa_comp_objetiva_pre ~ ai_disclosure_fonasa * device_type, data = data),

    lm(fonasa_comp_subjetiva_pre ~ ai_disclosure_fonasa + device_type, data = data),
    lm(fonasa_comp_subjetiva_pre ~ ai_disclosure_fonasa * device_type, data = data),

    lm(fonasa_conf_word_moral_pre ~ ai_disclosure_fonasa + device_type, data = data),
    lm(fonasa_conf_word_moral_pre ~ ai_disclosure_fonasa * device_type, data = data)
  ),
  collapse.se = TRUE,
  show.ci = FALSE,
  show.aic = FALSE,
  show.r2 = TRUE,
  show.fstat = TRUE,
  p.style = "stars",
  dv.labels = c("Objective knowledge","Objective knowledge",
                "Subjective knowledge","Subjective knowledge",
                "Moral trust (MDMT)","Moral trust (MDMT)"),
  pred.labels = c("Intercept",
                  "AI disclosure (Ex-Ante)",
                  "Device: Mobile",
                  "AI disclosure × Device")
)

## =========================================================
## 2. Moderador: Primera intervención (SAE)
```

```{r}
library(sjPlot)
```

## Hipótesis 2

```{r}
library(sjPlot)

run_models <- function(moderator, moderator_label) {

  f1 <- as.formula(paste("sae_comp_objetiva_pre ~ disclosure *", moderator))
  f2 <- as.formula(paste("sae_comp_subjetiva_pre ~ disclosure *", moderator))
  f3 <- as.formula(paste("sae_conf_word_moral_pre ~ disclosure *", moderator))
  f4 <- as.formula(paste("sae_conf_word_funcional_pre ~ disclosure *", moderator))
  f5 <- as.formula(paste("sae_conf_belief_moral_pre ~ disclosure *", moderator))
  f6 <- as.formula(paste("sae_conf_belief_funcional_pre ~ disclosure *", moderator))

  tab_model(
    list(
      lm(f1, data = data),
      lm(f2, data = data),
      lm(f3, data = data),
      lm(f4, data = data),
      lm(f5, data = data),
      lm(f6, data = data)
    ),
    collapse.se = TRUE,
    show.ci = FALSE,
    show.aic = FALSE,
    show.r2 = TRUE,
    show.fstat = TRUE,
    p.style = "stars",
    dv.labels = c(
      "Objective knowledge",
      "Subjective knowledge",
      "Moral trust (MDMT)",
      "Functional trust (MDMT)",
      "Moral trust – beliefs (MDMT)",
      "Functional trust – beliefs (MDMT)"
    ),
    pred.labels = c(
      "Intercept",
      "Disclosure (Ex-Ante)",
      moderator_label,
      paste("Disclosure ×", moderator_label)
    )
  )
}

run_models("sae_familiaridad_3", "SAE familiarity: Yes")
run_models("uso_sae", "SAE use")
run_models("device_type", "Device: Mobile")
run_models("get_variable_ord", "First intervention: SAE")
run_models("attitudes_tech", "Technology attitudes")
run_models("attitudes_ai", "AI attitudes")
run_models("alfabetizacion_digital", "Digital literacy")
run_models("ai_skills", "AI skills")
```
